WITH signal_data AS (
  SELECT 
    s.modindex,
    s.phaseshiftdeg,
    t.telescregistry,
    o.weathprofile
  FROM signals s
  JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
  JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
  WHERE s.modindex IS NOT NULL AND s.phaseshiftdeg IS NOT NULL
),
telescope_weather_stats AS (
  SELECT 
    telescregistry,
    weathprofile,
    AVG(modindex) as avg_modindex,
    AVG(phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshift
  FROM signal_data
  GROUP BY telescregistry, weathprofile
),
weather_baselines AS (
  SELECT 
    weathprofile,
    AVG(avg_modindex) as baseline_modindex
  FROM telescope_weather_stats
  GROUP BY weathprofile
),
kept_groups AS (
  SELECT 
    tws.telescregistry,
    tws.weathprofile,
    tws.avg_modindex,
    tws.avg_phaseshift,
    wb.baseline_modindex
  FROM telescope_weather_stats tws
  JOIN weather_baselines wb ON tws.weathprofile = wb.weathprofile
  WHERE tws.avg_modindex > wb.baseline_modindex
)
SELECT 
  weathprofile,
  AVG(avg_modindex) as avg_kept_modindex,
  AVG(avg_phaseshift) as avg_kept_phaseshift,
  AVG(avg_modindex - baseline_modindex) as avg_above_baseline
FROM kept_groups
GROUP BY weathprofile
ORDER BY weathprofile
